editor.panel.starter_title: Run starter: the run begins with it
editor.panel.starter_max: The starter title is at most {max} characters
editor.panel.no_step_yet: There has been no step in this run yet
editor.panel.no_step_in_run: There is no step in the chosen run
editor.panel.spec_written: The task is written. It also opens with the MD badge on the card.
editor.panel.spec_empty_decision: Empty. For a decision the spec is the selection criterion: the leader takes a branch by it.
editor.panel.spec_empty: Empty. This is the task the leader sends to the worker word for word.
editor.panel.starter_exists: The folder already has a starter — block {no}.
editor.panel.starter_hint: The run begins with it. No worker is assigned; its spec is the run description for the leader.
editor.panel.hint_solo: In this mode the leader executes the blocks. The assignment is kept for the team mode.
editor.panel.hint_subagents: In the “Subagents” environment the leader chooses the executor. The assignment is kept for Orca and SendMessage.
editor.panel.hint_worker: A worker on the card gets the block; the leader or empty — the leader does it.
editor.panel.prop_empty_note: An empty value removes the property.
editor.panel.iso_note: X/Y/Z is the position. The “Size” mode on the canvas changes the length, depth and height of the body.
editor.panel.raw_hint: Red is what cannot be edited: id, number, type and folder. The rest can be changed, including x and y.
editor.panel.not_json: This is not JSON — the edit was not applied
editor.panel.hands_ok: You can set it by hand: the server writes it into run r{no} on behalf of a human.
editor.panel.hands_no: There is no run — nowhere to set the state.
editor.panel.share_scheme: Give the worker the whole picture of the scheme
editor.panel.share_hint: By default a worker sees only its own spec
editor.panel.delete_kids: Its subfolders will go with it: {n}.
editor.panel.delete_warn: The blocks, arrows and assets of this folder will be deleted too. This cannot be undone.
